Progress has no current heading or text and remains null. Secondary <Class> and absent completion do not override the primary.
Completion preserves relief at the player's quick arrival and the Sisterhood's request for aid. All four available states read coherently; first-use annotations and exact marker case pass.

Lady Sathrah remains along northern Teldrassil near Wellspring Lake. The objective asks for her identifiable Silvery Spinnerets to Priestess A'moora in Darnassus; no unsupported narrative quantity was added.
Progress preserves regret, Sathrah being beyond hope, and the hoped-for sacrifice/blessing/peaceful rebirth. Spinnerets are correctly rendered as silk-producing organs, not textile machinery.

Title preserves the identifying Sathrah's Sacrifice item8155; current five fields and installed priestess7313 identify the ritual after2518, rather than another collection step.
